name: What are the key steps in a commercial construction process?

mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in a commercial construction process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The commercial construction process generally begins with conceptual design and feasibility studies, followed by detailed architectural and engineering plans. Once designs are finalized, the project moves into the permitting phase, securing necessary approvals from local authorities. Construction then commences with site preparation, foundation work, structural framing, utility installation, interior build-out, and exterior finishes. The final stages involve quality inspections, commissioning, and client handover. Throughout, project management ensures coordination, budget adherence, and quality control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key steps include design, permitting, site preparation, construction, and final inspections. Project management oversees coordination and quality.
